Name: Waves

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Chooses the noise that modulates wave height, direction, and phase variation.

Params.Name: NoiseScale
Params.Label: Noise Scale
Params.Description: Sets the size of wave distortion and the noise that shifts wave phase.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values create more closely spaced wave variation.

Params.Name: NoiseSeed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Rearranges wave distortion and phase variation without changing the main wave scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use a new seed for a different wave surface.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Bends wave bands and phase sampling so the waves do not remain perfectly uniform.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it for more natural, disturbed wave patterns.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Offsets cellular feature points in wave distortion and phase detail.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; it changes local wave variation placement.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the overall height amplitude of the generated shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the overall strength of this base shape.

Params.Name: Scale
Params.Description: Controls the scale of the coordinate space used by the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create smaller, more frequent features.

Params.Name: Wavelength
Params.Description: Controls the distance between repeating wave crests.
Params.Tooltip: Increase wavelength for broader, more widely spaced waves.

Params.Name: WaveAmount
Params.Label: Wave Amount
Params.Description: Controls how strongly the wave pattern affects the terrain.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value for more pronounced waves.

Params.Name: Distortion
Params.Description: Controls the amount of procedural warping applied to the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Increase distortion for a less regular silhouette.

Params.Name: Octaves
Params.Description: Controls how many noise octaves contribute to the shape.
Params.Tooltip: More octaves add finer detail and increase generation cost.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Params.Name: Rotation
Params.Description: Rotates the shape's sampling coordinates around the terrain center.
Params.Tooltip: Use rotation to change the direction of directional features.

Description: Generates a waves-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
